manifest.partition: x slabs in [0,6]; rank boundaries cross inner disk at x=3
manifest.stamp: Fixture constant 1, not a production MPI generation ID
manifest.scope: Exchange already computed shared TCF faces; does not build distributed raw geometry or solve hydro/HG
manifest.tolerance: 1e-5 relative plus 1e-18 absolute on printed face quantities

limitations: Partition fixture is generated from one-rank CPU results; geometry and forces are not recomputed across ranks
Only common TCF face length/force/heat exchanged; raw endpoint records and distributed clipping remain unimplemented
Static fixture generation stamp, not actual MPI RK/retry synchronization
No distributed HG mode application, migration rollback, or multi-rank evolution claim
Periodic-image matching uses printed direction and persistent ID pair; this is not a production packed-record format
